# Where the files under test/fixtures/ come from

The fixtures the standalone host's tests of every Notion add-on's tool type read, one folder per add-on, `mindmap.dis`, the specification of a tool type that has no add-on, which the tests of reuse give the shared parts, and `disl.schema.json`, the JSON Schema of DISL, which the tests walk a specification beside. They are copied unchanged, byte for byte, from repositories of [etalii-adp](https://github.com/etalii-adp), which are licensed under the Apache License 2.0, as this repository is. Do not edit one here: a correction goes to its repository and arrives with a newer copy.

- Refresh them with `node scripts/sync-examples.mjs [<repository>=<git ref> ...]`.
- `node scripts/sync-examples.mjs --check` compares every copied file with the SHA-256 below.
